blogPosts.title: Signs You Need a New Hot Water System in Brisbane
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the top indicators that your hot water system needs replacement, especially in Brisbane's variable climate.
body: In Brisbane's hot summers and mild winters, a reliable hot water system is essential. Signs like inconsistent water temperature, strange noises, or leaks indicate it might be time for a replacement.
Age is a major factor. Most hot water systems last 10-15 years. If yours is nearing this age in Montpelier, consider upgrading to a more energy-efficient model suited to Queensland's climate.
Rising energy bills can signal inefficiency. Newer systems, such as solar or heat pump models, are designed for Australian conditions and can significantly reduce running costs in Brisbane.

Visible rust or corrosion on the tank means internal damage. This can lead to leaks and water contamination. In Montpelier's water supply, minerals might accelerate corrosion, so regular inspections are crucial.
Strange sounds like popping or rumbling suggest sediment buildup, reducing efficiency. Flushing the tank can help, but if problems persist, replacement is often more cost-effective.
Plumber Greaves in Montpelier can assess your hot water system and recommend the best options for your home, considering Brisbane's sunlight availability and energy rebates.

blogPosts.title: Preventing Blocked Drains in Montpelier Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Practical tips to keep your drains clear and avoid costly blockages in Montpelier properties.
body: Blocked drains are a common issue in Montpelier homes, often caused by hair, grease, food waste, or tree roots. Prevention starts with mindful habits, like using drain screens and avoiding pouring oils down the sink.

In Brisbane's subtropical climate, tree roots seek moisture and can invade pipes. Montpelier has mature trees, so regular drain inspections can catch root intrusion early before it causes major blockages.

Grease and fat buildup is another culprit. When cooled, they solidify in pipes, narrowing the passage. Using hot water and dish soap periodically can help, but professional cleaning is sometimes necessary.
Foreign objects like wet wipes or sanitary products should never be flushed. Even 'flushable' wipes can cause blockages. Educating household members is key to prevention.
Plumber Greaves offers drain cleaning services in Montpelier using advanced jet blasters to remove stubborn blockages. We also provide CCTV inspections to identify underlying issues.
Regular maintenance by a professional plumber can save Montpelier homeowners from emergency repairs and costly water damage, ensuring drains flow smoothly year-round.
